texts: Jeffrey Epstein's victims included dozens of underage girls, with many between the ages of 14 and 17. Recent investigations suggest that his trafficking network extended into Eastern Europe, where he recruited at least 30 underage girls from Romania and Ukraine between 1998 and 2002.
